Greetings, Agents!

 

CM Fragment here with the update details you’ve been waiting for!

 

The Mutant Strike team X-Force has been added in game! Through our March update, the Brotherhood of Mutants will make their move! How will this move affect MARVEL Future Fight? We’ve also prepared a variety of improvements in-game along with other changes written below. 

 

An all-new X-Force member to join our lineup, Warpath, the weapons master joins the fray! We also have Sabretooth and Juggernaut, two formidable opponents that can overwhelm you with their claws and massive power! Added 3 new characters!

 

And of course, the X-Force line-up would not be complete without enhancements made to the following characters: Deadpool, Wolverine, and Nightcrawler. Enhance them through their new uniforms! Added 3 new uniforms!

 

Four more characters can now realize their inner Potential! Along with Wolverine's Tier-3 Upgrade,
Enter the all-new Shadowland and test out the expansion and improvements made to Shadowland!


We’ve also added an X-Force-themed Uniform Collection and a Comic Card!

 

Other game improvements, enhancements, and other game fixes have also been added.


▣ 3 New Characters Added!

An all new member of the X-Force, the Apache mutant Warpath along with two powerful super villains: Sabretooth and Juggernaut, has been added in the game!

 

 

 

 

* The skill descriptions shown above are at Skill Level 1.

 

▣ 3 New Uniforms Added!

 

New uniforms have been added in celebration of X-Force’s arrival in-game!

Use these new uniforms to complete missions the X-Force way.

New uniforms for Deadpool, Wolverine, and Nightcrawler have been added.

 

* The Skill descriptions shown above are at Skill Level 1.

* 3 new uniforms will be on sale during the event period. You can check them out on the Marvel Universe menu and by going to the Uniform Room.
 

▣ 4 More Characters Can Now Realize Their Potential!

The March update will allow you to realize the potential of the characters below.
Wolverine, Sabretooth, Warpath, and Juggernaut. You can now raise them up to Level 70.

 

 

▣ New Tier-3 Upgrade!

Awaken the true power of one of the best mutant warriors, Wolverine.

Watch his ultimate skill below and unleash the power of his Adamantium claws!



 


 

▣ Shadowland Improvements
There are more reasons to love Shadowland once our March update lands! We’ve added more than 31 floors and the interface has been improved! Enjoy our all-new Shadowland which is different from the usual!
Once you’re able to clear Stage 30 of Shadowland, you can now challenge infinite floors, along with contesting the current King of the Hill.

 

 

- 1 random stage will be selected from the 31st floor and above.

- If you clear the highest floor faster than everyone else, your code name will appear in Shadowland's Highest Cleared Floor screen.

 

Characters that have reached 6★ and Tier 2 are the only characters that can participate in infinite floor mode. The higher the floor, the harder the stages will be.

 

- You can refresh the stage you encounter upon reaching Floor 31 and above in exchange of Gold.
-  The bosses you face on Floor 31 and up will have additional stats, which depends on the randomly selected Fight Floor, from Floors 1-30.
 

In addition, you can earn Shadow Points upon clearing each floor, starting from Floor 31 and above.
The amount of Shadow Points you earn depends on the number of your remaining characters after the stage is cleared.  

Accumulating a certain amount of Shadow Points will get you a Shadowland Chest.

Get various rewards such as C.T.P.’s and other rewards in the Shadowland Chest.

* Since the current Shadowland season continues once the update lands, you can only go up to Floor 30. Once the reset happens, you can now go up to Floor 31 onwards.
* Your current Shadowland records and ranking prior to the update will be retained.
 

▣ New Uniform Collection Theme Added

We have added 2 X-Force themes for your Uniform Collection!

Get your uniforms up to a certain rank to complete your collection!
[X-FORCE #1]

[X-FORCE #2]

- Complete the collection within a certain period and receive additional special rewards!

 

▣ New Comic Card Added

A new X-Force themed Comic Card has been added as well.

This Comic Card can be acquired in the Dimension Rift - Lost Warrior (Warpath), and the Shop.

[X-FORCE (2008) # 24]

- Fixed options include Dodge rate up and Ignore defense, while some random options include increase All Attacks, reduced Cooldown Duration, and increased Energy Attack and etc!

 

▣ Sabretooth Package Guide

 

Wolverine’s sworn enemy! 
Sabretooth, a warrior that also has an active healing factor and adamantium claws, has arrived in MARVEL Future Fight!
You can grab this powerful supervillain mutant by purchasing our new Sabretooth package. 
 
The Sabretooth package comes with a 6★ Sabretooth and Gold on your first purchase, and upon your second purchase and so on, you’ll be able to get Sabretooth X-Genes and Rank-Up materials.

  

* You can purchase the Sabretooth Package 2 any time after purchasing Package 1.
* This package is available at all times until further notice. 

 

▣ Other Game Improvements

1. Improvements on selecting a quantity of certain items for purchase in the store.

- You can set the number of purchases for Energy and Clear Tickets only.

 

2. Dimension Rift - Lost Warrior has been added. 

- Comic Cards and Warpath X-Genes are available in this Dimension Rift.


▣ Other Game Fixes

1.  An issue with Nick Fury (Modern) and Nick Fury (MARVEL’s Captain Marvel) where upon the activation of their S.H.I.E.L.D. Air Strike skill, the bombardment effect disappears unexpectedly has been fixed.
2. Deadpool (Modern)’s Character Tips have been changed.
3. The issue with Captain Marvel (MARVEL’s Captain Marvel)’s uniform where if she is used in auto play, there are certain scenarios where she can use her Ultimate Skill continuously has been fixed.
4. An issue with Captain Marvel (MARVEL’s Captain Marvel)’s uniform where upon using her with Auto-Play enabled, the character stops moving has been fixed.
5. Corrected a visual glitch with Captain Marvel (All Uniforms) where the color of the Earth and the Meteors on her Ultimate skill is showing incorrectly.


Thank you.
